t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a limestone background. Large light-weight sans-serif headline in deep navy across the top with a small breadcrumb. Left two-thirds: a square-cornered framed macro 3D render of layered translucent membrane sheets and rippling water with woven mesh texture, cool silver-blue, soft diffuse light, with fine dimension lines and rotated measurements on its edges and thin leader-line callouts. Right third: a numbered list with slash numbers, monospace detail lines and hairline separators for <CONTENT>.
signature_idea: A dimensioned macro of membrane layers sits beside a numbered compliance index, like a figure plate next to its legend.
strengths: light headline, mono details, limestone ground and hairlines match the brand
list format is scannable for standards and inspectors
dimension lines bring a drawing-sheet precision to a photo
weaknesses: macro image is decorative and unrelated to the list; callouts point at nothing meaningful
table becomes a list, losing column comparison
large image takes two-thirds of the space from the actual data
brand_fit_why: Limestone, navy text, light headline, mono figures, hairlines and square corners fit; the photo-real liquid macro is softer than the line-art brand and adds little information.
